div.b: Cure screen — every second while the run is running
div.br:
• Door open → 10 s countdown; door closed in time → run continues
• Chamber sensor lost (9010) → run paused → Retry / Stop process
• Frozen reading (9006) → run paused → Stop process
• Fan failure (9020–9025, 9030–9034) → run paused →
Continue anyway (fan overridden) / Stop process
• LED panel not heating (9040–9045, only with LED checks on) →
run paused → Continue anyway / Stop process
• Ramp / cooling: < 1 °C progress per 5 min, 5 times →
Temperature Warning (7004) → Continue / Abort
Operator
• Pause → Pause & Open Door: outputs off, clocks frozen,
door released → Continue (door closed) / Stop Process
• Abort → Stop the Cure Process? → Yes, Stop
